META.PUBLISH_BODY: The Flow becomes available and is sent to Meta.
META.PUBLISH_POINT_INBOXES: It will be available in every inbox of ChatHub.
META.PUBLISH_POINT_META: It is sent to Meta on every WhatsApp Cloud account of this account. Other channels keep it internal.
META.PUBLISH_POINT_VERSION: Meta does not allow changes to the content of a published Flow. When you publish changes, ChatHub creates a new version and requests retirement of the previous one.
META.PUBLISH_FAILED: Meta did not accept the Flow on some accounts. Fix what it says and retry.
META.PUBLISH_ERROR: The Flow could not be sent to Meta.
META.NO_CLOUD: This account has no WhatsApp Cloud channel to publish to.
META.SAVE_FIRST: Save the Flow first: it is the saved version that is sent.
META.FIX_FIRST: Fix the mistakes of the Flow first.
META.TEST_DESCRIPTION: Sends the saved Flow to a number as a message, without publishing it.
META.TEST_WINDOW: The number must have written to your business in the last 24 hours, or WhatsApp will not deliver it.
META.UNPUBLISHED_CHANGES_BANNER: You changed this Flow after publishing it. Publish it again so customers receive the new version.

DETAIL.TITLE: WhatsApp publication

DETAIL.EMPTY: No WhatsApp business accounts match your filters.
DETAIL.ALL_WABAS: Publishing includes every WhatsApp Cloud WABA.
DETAIL.RETRY_QUEUED: Retry queued. Refresh to see the result.
